Which of the following statements is most accurate?

A) The lettuce is on top of a bowl
B) The tomato is placed next to the honey
C) There are three stacks of paper plates of the same size
D) All jars are closed Choices:  A. The lettuce is on top of a bowl. B. The tomato is placed next to the honey. C. There are three stacks of paper plates of the same size. D. All jars are closed. Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
